source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Filimon»

attestations.note: The page the calendar links under this name carries the name and nothing else — no life, no troparion, no year — so nothing identifies him with any other Philemon the corpus keeps.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Φιλήμων, Άρχιππος και Ονήσιμος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and keeps him in a line of three exactly as doxologia does. The page gives no year. It closes with a remark of its own: «Η μνήμη του Αγίου Φιλήμονος, περιττώς επαναλαμβάνεται, από ορισμένους Συναξαριστές και την 6η Ιουνίου» — certain synaxarists needlessly repeat his memory on 6 June as well. That is saint.gr reporting other books and not keeping a second day of its own, so nothing is moved and the second day is recorded here. The third man of the line has no folder and is drafted as `onesimus-6-july`. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
